# Digi-Tec Performance Center

> Digi-Tec Performance Center is an independent car workshop in Dubai, UAE, established in 2002. It provides maintenance, diagnostics, repair, paint protection, and performance services for European, luxury, and performance vehicles.

## Business details

- Website: https://digitecme.com
- Phone and WhatsApp: +971 4 340 2223
- Email: info@digitecme.com
- Address: Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Dubai, UAE
- Established: 2002
